claims.statement: Net capex was ₹1,206 million in FY24
Free cash flow turned positive at ₹435 million in FY24 from negative ₹2,791 million in FY23
Total store count increased to 444 in FY24 from 423 in FY23 (V-Mart 365, Unlimited 79)
Targeting 8-10% same-store sales growth for two consecutive years to reach pre-COVID EBITDA margin of 8%.
Plan to open 40-50 new stores in FY25 with potential closure of 5-7 underperforming stores.
Limeroad losses targeted at less than half of FY24 levels (40-50% of prior year loss).
Consolidated gross margin at 31.7%, down 20 bps YoY due to higher old inventory liquidation and conservative provisioning; V-Mart gross margin down 0.5%.
Not targeting higher gross margin percentage; focus on volume growth and rupee gross margin per store at effective prices.
V-Mart sales grew 13% with 6% L2L; Unlimited L2L grew 13%; Limeroad revenue grew 29%.
FY24 capex incurred Rs. 137 crores (net ~Rs. 120 crores); ~50% on new warehouse operational since June, Rs. 40 crores on 46 new stores, Rs. 26 crores on renovations.
Opened 46 stores, closed 25 in FY24; net store count reduced in Unlimited; new Unlimited stores in Tier-3/4 South India delivering 15-20% higher sales per sq ft than legacy stores.
LimeRoad losses reduced by 60% YoY and 15% QoQ in Q1FY25

Offline gross margin healthy; overall gross margin down 60 bps due to LimeRoad revenue decline. Full-year offline gross margins expected to remain at last year's levels. Entity EBITDA 12.6% (V-Mart core 13.4%, Unlimited 18%) including INR 1

Targeting quarter-on-quarter reduction in LimeRoad EBITDA loss (20-30% per quarter); full-year LimeRoad loss expected to be less than 50% of prior year. Offline margin expansion not targeted in percentage terms; focus on rupee margin growth

INR 26 crores spent in Q1 on new store openings and refurbishments. Full-year store opening runway maintained at 50-odd stores (gross), mostly opening in Q2 and Q3. Most unprofitable store closures completed; 3-4 regular closures may still
Opened 7 new stores in Q1 (5 North V-Mart, 2 South Unlimited); closed 3 Unlimited stores. Net Unlimited store count at 78 after closing 19 and opening 23 in South over 3 years.

Full-year store opening target: 50-odd gross stores (mostly Q2-Q3). LimeRoad losses to reduce quarter-on-quarter; full-year loss <50% of prior year. Offline margin % to be retained; rupee margin growth via volumes. No further price cuts at
Full-year store opening guidance maintained at 55-60 stores for FY25.
Capex spend of INR 35 crores in Q2 FY25, primarily for new store openings and store refurbishments.
Opened 16 new stores in Q2 FY25 (V-Mart and Unlimited) and closed 2 V-Mart stores; run rate maintained for 55-60 stores in FY25.
Offline gross margin improved 0.6% YoY due to lower discounting and higher festive mix; overall gross margin down 1% YoY due to 53% drop in LimeRoad commission revenue.
Offline EBITDA at 7.1% (V-Mart 6.6%, Unlimited 9.4%); entity EBITDA at 5.8% including INR 7 crore LimeRoad loss.
LimeRoad losses to keep declining quarter-on-quarter; aim to make losses negligible in 1.5-2 years; no breakeven guarantee.
Target 12-13% square feet growth annually for FY26 onward; expansion disciplined by property quality, cost, and ROI.
Aspire to return to pre-COVID ~8% EBITDA margin in 2-3 years driven by same-store sales growth and efficiency; gross margin pressure from competition expected.
Targeting mid to high single-digit growth going forward
Target 50-plus net store additions for full year FY25
Target reducing inventory days by at least 5% to 87-88 days
Gross margin 35.8%, up 30 bps YoY; prepared to compromise product margins to sharpen value proposition
V-Mart core EBITDA 17.9%, up 130 bps YoY; total company EBITDA 16.7%, up 43% YoY
Priority is retaining customers over margins; will not pass on cost inflation to consumers
YTD capex Rs. 83 crores for 49 new stores and refurbishments; new warehouse fully stabilized
Opened 21 stores in Q3 (19 V-Mart, 2 Unlimited); total 488 stores pan India, 85 in South
New stores delivering best sales per sq ft in last five years; rental threshold below 6.5-7%
Like-to-like sales grew 10% aggregate (V-Mart 19%, Unlimited 6%); footfalls up ~40%
Net capex was ₹1,224 million in FY25
LimeRoad loss reduced by 57% in FY25 and 43% in Q4FY25
Management expects overall growth of 17-20% and net retail area addition of 13-15% in FY26
NSO guidance remains around 12% area addition annually net of 1-2% closures
FY25 capex was INR 122 crores for 62 new stores and upgrades; incremental warehouse capex planned in 1-1.5 years
Operated 503 stores as of April 2025 after 62 net openings in FY25; target ~65 new stores in FY26
Q4 FY25 gross margin 33.1% (+140 bps YoY) driven by full-price summer sell-through and lower LimeRoad contribution; expected to remain range-bound
V-Mart core EBITDA 9.5% (+170 bps), Unlimited 10.8% (+170 bps); consolidated 8.7% (+69% YoY) including LimeRoad
Without ESOP expense, Q4 EBITDA 9.6% and FY25 EBITDA 12.1%
Warehouse expansion from 5 lakh to 8 lakh sq ft planned in 1-1.5 years with automation investments
Monsoon outlook positive; expects farm/rural income growth to support consumption momentum
Targeting 12-15% net area addition annually with 1-2% closures, expecting at least 65 net new stores in FY26
Expecting healthy consistent same-store sales growth and at least 13-14% additional square feet area in FY26
Gross margin ex-LimeRoad improved 60 bps to 34.8%; total gross margin up 10 bps to 35.3%; focusing on rupee gross margin over percentage
EBITDA margin ex-LimeRoad 14.9% (+80 bps YoY); total EBITDA margin 14.3% (+170 bps YoY); LimeRoad losses reduced 56%
Conservative on percentage EBITDA margin guidance; focusing on rupee margins and higher full-price sell-through rather than percentage margins
YTD capex INR 30 crores primarily for new store openings and refurbishments
Targeting 12-15% net area addition annually; on track for expansion cycle with big pipeline built
Full-year new store opening guidance increased to 75 stores
Full-year same-store sales growth guidance maintained at mid to high single digit
Full-year EBITDA expected to show marginal improvement over last year
Capex of Rs 30 crore spent in Q2 FY26 on new store openings and store refurbishments
Net store count reached 549 as of November 2025 after adding 40 stores in H1 and 16 more in October-November
Consolidated gross margin flat at 33.6% in Q2 FY26; offline gross margin improved 60 bps YoY excluding Limeroad commission income
Offline EBITDA margin at 8.9% in Q2 FY26 with V-Mart at 9.3% and Unlimited at 9.9%
Pre-India EBITDA turned positive at 1% in Q2 FY26 versus -3% last year
YTD FY26 net capex ₹1,171 Mn
23 new store openings in Q3 FY26 (21 V-Mart, 2 Unlimited)
Offline gross margins expanded 70 bps YoY due to better inventory health, less discounting, and improved product mix from marriage season.
Pre-IndAS EBITDA margin improved from 10.8% to 12.2%; post-IndAS EBITDA grew 22% YoY to INR 210 crores with margins expanding 190 bps to 18.6%.
Full-year offline gross margins expected to remain broadly stable versus last year as value proposition focuses on volume-led growth.
Capex for Q3 was INR 57 crores primarily for new store additions and selective refurbishments.
Targeting 75-plus new store additions for FY26 as communicated in last quarter's call.
Added 23 new stores in Q3, taking total store count to 554; new stores ramping up faster than historical averages.
Long-term target of 13-14% annual square footage addition; 60-65% of expansion from new towns in existing states.
YTD PAT grown almost 3x to INR 113 crores reflecting consistency; positive free cash flow of INR 63 crores, up 9.4% YoY.
Rental per sq ft: V-Mart ~INR 48-49, Unlimited ~INR 65; rental cost as % of sales to decline as SSG grows.
Capital expenditure Rs 160.11 crore
Gross margin decreased 1% YoY due to inventory provision and 12% decline in LimeRoad commission income; improved inventory health should drive better gross margins forward
EBITDA grew 56% YoY to INR106 crores with margins expanding 220 bps to 10.9% due to better cost absorption and productivity gains
Capex for Q4 FY26 was INR37 crores, INR159 crores for full year; estimated at INR170-180 crores for next year including tech/AI investments
Opened 29 stores in Q4 and 92 in full year with 12 closures; guidance remains 13-15% area addition annually net of 1-2% closures
Targeting 15-18% ROC currently at 14.5%, aiming for 20%+ and eventually 22%+ as LimeRoad/Unlimited investments mature
Capex per store remains INR1.3-1.4 crores; higher average due to store refurbishments (every 4-6 years) and backend investments; tech/AI spending increasing
Rent expense at 8% of sales, targeting 6-7.5% medium term; new stores planned at <7% rent to sales
Blocked 50-60% of fabric needs till December; advance booking better than peers; no margin hiccup expected but focusing on product availability and value

Gross margin declined 80 bps to 34.5% due to mix change and regular provision on aged inventory; inventory productivity improved with days of inventory down 8% YoY to 86 days and inventory per store down 5% to INR 1.5 crore.

Total expenses grew 15% vs 23% revenue growth, delivering 150 bps operating leverage; pre-IndAS EBITDA grew 36% YoY to INR 83 crore with margin expanding to 7.6% from 6.9%; post-IndAS EBITDA grew 27% to INR 161 crore with margin at 14.8%.
LimeRoad marketplace losses reduced 39% YoY and 7% QoQ despite 18% NMV growth; EBITDA loss now in insignificant and manageable range.
Capex for the quarter was INR 38 crores primarily for new store additions and selective refurbishments; business generated positive cash flows of INR 76 crores.

Q2 is a small quarter with Durga Puja shifting by 19 days into Q3, causing negative impact on sales and margins vs last year; this is a timing issue expected to recover with good festive-to-festive growth in Q3.
Management targets mid-to-high single digit SSG for the year, aiming to better last year's SSG.

Plan to accelerate Unlimited store openings in Southern markets; expect higher number of store openings compared to last year from South; target similar EBITDA margins for Unlimited and V-Mart formats over time.
Total stores 613 as of 30 Sep 2026 (V-Mart 509, Unlimited 104); net addition 22 in Q2 FY27
Retail space 5.2 million sq ft as of YTD FY27 (V-Mart 4.3, Unlimited 0.9), up 14% YoY
Management targets 17-20% total sales growth and 90-100 new store openings in FY27
Net capex for H1 FY27 was INR 85 crores vs INR 60 crores last year, mainly for new stores, refurbishments, new office and technology
